title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
description: We are hiring a senior full-stack engineer for a real-time data platform. The product ingests operational events, computes fresh aggregates, and pushes them to a websocket dashboard that on-call engineers actually watch. You will work in TypeScript across a React client and the services behind it. We care that the build passes, that the hard paths have tests, and that you have owned a streaming or realtime surface in production, not only described one. You will share on-call for the pipeline you ship.

personaExpectations.project_manager: I need someone who owned a realtime surface end to end, can separate what shipped from what is still a design, and whose dates and scope match the repository.
personaExpectations.staff_engineer: I need production-shaped code: a build that passes, tests around the hard parts, and an architecture that is actually in the repo rather than only in the README. The complexity should match the claims.
personaExpectations.associate_engineer: I need readable code and evidence they learn in public. I am looking for someone who could take a ticket on our pipeline in the first month, not a person who has only copied a tutorial.
